subject: Pinnacle Health: sudden throughput drop and 5xx spike — prefetch/kv imbalance
messages:
From: Alex Conway <alex.conway@pinnaclehealth.com>
To: support@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@pinnaclehealth.com>
Date: 2029-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production: sudden throughput drop + 5xx spike (tenant: pinnacle-app)

Hi Redwood team,

We observed a sharp degradation this morning across our routed inference endpoints for pinnacle-app. Throughput fell ~60% and p99 latency jumped from ~220ms to >1.8s. We're also seeing a lot of 502/503 errors and partial responses. This started just after our scheduled model refresh at 03:00 UTC (no config changes on our side).

Attached is a short timeline and a few sample request ids. The impact is customer-visible — several downstream requests are timing out. Can you triage?

Sample request ids: req_12ab3c, req_12ab7f, req_12abdd
Impact window: 2029-09-28T02:56:00Z onward

Thank you,
Alex Conway
Head of Platform, Pinnacle Health

Hi Alex / Priya — Rafael from Redwood here. Sorry you're seeing this. I'm escalating immediately to Eng + Ops and will own coordination.

Initial plan:
- Ben + Grace to collect KV/prefetch metrics and tenant config snapshot (already requested).
- Short mitigation: isolate pinnacle-app to a dedicated lane (reduce cross-tenant interference) and temporarily reduce prefetch aggressiveness for that tenant.
- If that doesn't stabilize within 30–45m, fallback traffic to the model variant we had before the refresh (we can do a targeted rollout).

Ben / Grace / Tessa — can you confirm we have the keys/rights to change the tenant's lane and what rollback looks like? I'll loop in Marissa (CS leadership) if this escalates to exec attention.

We'll update every 15 minutes.

— Rafael

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2029-09-28T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sudden throughput drop + 5xx spike (tenant: pinnacle-app)

On Sep 28, 2029 09:34 AM, Rafael Mendes wrote:
> Initial plan: isolate pinnacle-app to a dedicated lane and temporarily reduce prefetch aggressiveness for that tenant.

Status / findings from the first 10m of dumps (attached):
- The tenant exhibits high prefix cardinality after the model refresh; prefetch is populating many unique KV keys, causing rapid evictions for the hot set.
- Eviction/backpressure is cascading into HOL (head-of-line) blocking on several batch lanes: when a request for a hot key stalls waiting on a KV fetch, it blocks the lane's batch and delays unrelated requests.
- Result: small batches pile up into longer latency windows and we start getting 502/503 from internal timeouts.

Immediate mitigations I recommend (in order):
1) Reduce prefetch window for pinnacle-app to minimal (disable cross-prefix prefetch temporarily). Command: 'redwood tenant set-prefetch pinnacle-app --window 0' (we have access).
2) Force the tenant into a dedicated hot-lane pool to avoid impacting other tenants: 'redwood lane assign pinnacle-app --pool hot-dedicated-2'.
3) Apply aggressive LRU eviction policy for the tenant's KV namespace to limit thrash: 'redwood kv set-policy pinnacle_app_ns --policy lru --max-entries 5m'.
4) Short-term: shrink batch size for the endpoint by 25% to reduce HOL blocking while prefetch stabilizes.

Rollback plan: revert prefetch and lane assignment; restore batch size. Each step can be reversed with the corresponding CLI. We'll perform changes sequentially and monitor p99 and 5xx.

I will run (1) + (2) now and report.

— Ben
Principal Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
(attachment: kv_metrics_20291002.csv)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, rafael.mendes@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Production: sudden throughput drop + 5xx spike (tenant: pinnacle-app)

Applying Ben's mitigations in the next maintenance window (ETA 10:10 AM PT). Steps I'll perform in order:
- Snapshot tenant-config -> tenant-config-pinnacle-snapshot.json (saved).
- Set prefetch window to 0 for pinnacle-app.
- Reassign lane to hot-dedicated-2.
- Reduce batch size for endpoint 'pinnacle-rtr' by 25%.
- Enable detailed tracing for the tenant for 48h and preserve traces in our secure bucket.

I'll monitor error rate and p99 every 5 minutes and post updates. If we don't see improvement within 30 minutes of the first change, I'll prepare to fail traffic to the previous model variant and CC Marissa for exec awareness.

— Grace
SRE, Redwood Inference

Thanks team — saw the mitigation go in and latency is back to normal ranges, error rate dropped to baseline. We did a quick smoke on patient-lookup and core search; all good.

We attached an anonymized request trace and two samples of the earlier 502s (in case it's useful). We may follow up about whether you can automatically limit prefetch for tenants after model refreshes — this caused a 40m outage window for us.

Appreciate the quick handling. We'll review the traces and get back on the credit/penalty conversation if needed.

— Alex Conway
